c.tagline: Australia's Red Centre heart: outback ranges, Aboriginal art, and the gateway to Uluru.

taxi.fareNote: Taxis are metered and booked through Alice Springs Taxis or the 13cabs app; rideshare such as Uber does not operate in Alice Springs, and there is no public bus to the airport, so pre-booking a taxi, airport shuttle or hire car is essential.

emergency.note: 000 is Australia's emergency number for police, fire and ambulance; 112 also works from mobile phones.

english.label: Easy to get by in English

solo.f: extra caution advised, especially after dark

avoid.reason: Elevated alcohol-related and property crime; caution in the CBD after dark

hood_desc: The compact heart of town around the pedestrian Todd Mall, lined with Aboriginal art galleries, cafes, pubs and the weekend market; the walkable base close to museums and tour departures.
A leafy older residential quarter just east of the Todd River, known for its shady streets, local cafes and an easygoing, arty neighbourhood feel.
The southern approach at Heavitree Gap, where the MacDonnell Ranges pinch the road, river and railway together; a handful of resorts and lodges at the literal gateway to town.
A quiet western suburb along Larapinta Drive heading toward the West MacDonnell Ranges, with family homes, budget lodges and easy access to the ranges and Desert Park.
A calm eastern estate built around a championship golf course and the ranges, offering resort-style stays and self-contained apartments away from the town-centre bustle.

water.note: Tap water is safe to drink, though the mineral taste leads some to prefer bottled.

transit.hours: Town buses run roughly 7:30am to 6pm on weekdays with limited Saturday services and little on Sundays; taxis cover the evenings.
transit.note: Alice Springs has a small public bus network (ASBus) covering the town and suburbs; there is no rail commuter or tram service, so most visitors rely on taxis, tour coaches or a hire car to reach the outback attractions.
transit.pay: Fares are paid in cash to the driver or with a prepaid Tap and Ride card; day passes offer better value for a full day of sightseeing.

bus: Alice Springs coach terminal (Greyhound interstate coaches)

car.idp: English licence accepted (IDP if not in English)

transit.m: Alice Springs Airport Shuttle to town-centre hotels (book ahead), ~20 min
Taxi to the town centre, ~15 min

tip.r: Tipping is not expected in Australia; wages are high and service is included, though rounding up for great service is welcome.
